meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,你的机器人就能通过个人微信收发消息:私聊和群聊消息会交给已接线的智能体处理并自动回复。
howto.when: 当你提出要接入个人微信、说“给机器人加微信”等,或在 /setup 安装流程中需要微信时,就会执行安装、扫码登录,并把微信消息接到智能体。

say.text: 给我这个机器人加上个人微信
say.note: 会执行安装流程并让你扫码登录微信

say.text: 微信私聊来了消息,交给默认智能体回复
say.note: 会运行接线脚本,把微信消息接到指定智能体

say.text: 陌生微信用户发消息时,先给我审批
say.note: 之后陌生人来消息会先弹审批卡片

howto.what_en: After install, the running agent gets a WeChat channel: it receives DMs and group-chat messages through a personal WeChat account and hands them to a wired agent group to process and reply.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add personal WeChat or add a WeChat channel to the bot, or during a /setup flow that needs it. Performs install, QR login, and wiring to an agent group.

say_en.text: Connect my personal WeChat to this bot
say_en.note: Runs the install flow and asks you to scan a QR code

say_en.text: Let the default agent reply to incoming WeChat DMs
say_en.note: Runs the script to wire the chat to an agent group

say_en.text: Require approval before strangers' WeChat messages reach the agent
say_en.note: Unknown senders get an approval card first
